deviations_and_open_questions: (1) A real implementation bug was found and fixed during THIS pass's own testing: GAP's QUIT statement cannot be used inside a while-loop body (syntax error) -- the driver's time-budget-stop and DROP-stop paths originally used QUIT and were rewritten to use a boolean DSDStopFlag + continue instead, then re-tested and confirmed working. Reported transparently, consistent with this whole campaign's practice of not smoothing over self-caught bugs.

(2) DROP contract's actual halt behavior (not just the check-and-log path) was not exercised on a real drop, since none occurred in the 6 windows tested -- the code path exists and was read/reviewed but a genuine end-to-end DROP-halt-and-resume-refusal test was not performed (would require either finding a real drop window or deliberately injecting one, neither done in this pass).
(3) Old (pre-v2) receipt files were not renamed -- see item4 scope note.

(4) The degree guard (item 6, prior pass) is wired into this driver's loop (DSDMaxDegree check, skips windows with degree>2000) but was not exercised this pass either, since none of the 6 dry-run windows are anywhere near that degree.
(5) c-in-M grounding remains an unresolved framework assumption, unchanged, throughout.
